mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to decreased aggregate demand, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) environment signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity markets and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with declining payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp and PAYEMS declines > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
